objective: Evaluate a volatility-breakout paper-trading strategy and execute only simulator-approved orders inside the daily risk budget.

contract.objective: Evaluate a volatility-breakout paper-trading strategy and execute only simulator-approved orders inside the daily risk budget.
contract.state: Market snapshot id, candidate signal, risk budget, verifier decision, paper orders, and performance report.
contract.action: Generate a candidate signal, verify it against deterministic risk limits, execute approved paper orders, and update the audit log.
contract.progress: Each cycle produces an approved/rejected decision, a paper order or explicit no-op, and updated drawdown/exposure metrics.
contract.invariant: No live orders, no position above 2% notional exposure, and no memory update without verifier approval.
contract.stopCondition: Four market snapshots are evaluated, the daily paper-order budget is exhausted, or risk guard fails.
contract.failureCondition: Verifier rejects two consecutive signals for the same risk reason or drawdown exceeds the paper limit.
contract.recovery: Stop execution, keep the audit log immutable, and require human review before changing risk limits.
contract.evidence: Verifier decisions, paper-order audit records, metric summary, and kill-switch status.
